user.title: DISH Receiver
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should reach your receiver. If the receiver was found on the network, its address is pre-filled.

pair.title: Start pairing
pair.description: Home Assistant will ask the receiver at {host} to show a pairing PIN on the TV. If the serial couldn't be detected automatically, enter it (Menu → Settings → Diagnostics → System Status, starts with "R"). Leave blank to auto-detect, then submit.

pair_pin.title: Enter the PIN
pair_pin.description: A PIN should now be on the TV connected to {host}. Enter it here to finish pairing. (If no PIN appeared, make sure pairing is allowed: Menu → Settings → Paired Devices.)

cloud.title: DISH Anywhere account
cloud.description: Sign in with your DISH Anywhere credentials.

delegate.title: Delegate to a remote
delegate.description: Pick an existing Home Assistant remote entity (IR blaster, Harmony, ESPHome) that will send the key presses.

ssdp_confirm.title: DISH Receiver found
ssdp_confirm.description: Home Assistant found {name} at {host} on the network. Submit to start pairing.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the receiver at that address.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Re-enable Pairing Request on the receiver and try the PIN again.

abort.already_configured: This receiver is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not determine the discovered receiver's address.

init.title: DISH Receiver options
init.description: Favorites let you tune by name (media_player source / select_source). One per line, as Name=Channel, e.g. ESPN=140.

send_key.name: Send key
send_key.description: Send a single raw remote key to the receiver.

key.name: Key
key.description: A key name, e.g. guide, info, channel_up, select, red.

tune_channel.name: Tune channel
tune_channel.description: Tune the receiver directly to a channel number.

launch_app.name: Launch app
launch_app.description: Launch a streaming app on the receiver (e.g. Netflix, YouTube).

app.name: App
app.description: App name as registered via DIAL (Netflix, YouTube).
